plain.li: {PAWN_nameDef} sat down between {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} and didn't let either of them leave until both had said their piece.
{PAWN_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} what their quarrel was really about, and made them both answer.
{PAWN_nameDef} heard {A_nameDef} out, then {B_nameDef}, then told them both the same thing.
[night] {PAWN_nameDef} kept {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} up late, talking their quarrel through.
[winter] {PAWN_nameDef} got {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} onto the same bench, out of the cold, to talk it over.

warm.li: {PAWN_nameDef} poured tea for {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} and sat with them until the pot went cold.

blunt.li: {PAWN_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} to settle it or stop sulking through every meal.

cheerful.li: {PAWN_nameDef} got {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} laughing at the same joke, feud or no feud.

gloomy.li: {PAWN_nameDef} reminded {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} how few of them there were out here to waste on a feud.

cold.li: {PAWN_nameDef} listed, calmly, everything the feud between {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} had cost the colony.
